component.name: Shapr3D for Linux
component.summary: Run the Windows version of Shapr3D

description.p: Runs the Windows version of Shapr3D on wine-uwp, a patched Wine for packaged Windows Store apps. This is an unofficial project, not affiliated with Shapr3D.

On first start, a setup downloads Microsoft's Windows 11 evaluation image from Microsoft, keeps the Windows components Shapr3D needs, and installs the Shapr3D for Windows package you choose. Nothing of Microsoft's or Shapr3D's is included in this package.
